完成 ÷（完成 + 未完成）—— 分母就是上面那两个数字: done ÷ (done + not done) — the denominator is exactly those two numbers above
从 Backlog 拖入 / 双击空白格建临时块（漂流内部建的不算）: Dragged in from Backlog / temp blocks from double-clicking an empty cell (not counting ones created inside drift)
拖动 / 键盘 / 从 Backlog 放入导致起点变化: Start time changed by dragging / keyboard / dropping in from Backlog
拉伸或键盘改时长: Resized, or duration changed with the keyboard
自己点的「漂」（不含自动顺延）: “Drift” you clicked yourself (not counting automatic shifts)
序列 / 漂流把后面的块连带挪走: Sequences / drift dragging the blocks after them along
一次删多个（含漂流后续）算在一起: Deleting several at once (including drift followers) counts as one
相邻的同一任务的块自动合并（每次吃掉 1 块）: Touching blocks of the same task merge automatically (ate 1 block each time)
{complete} 次完成都还没有时长记录: None of the {complete} completions have a duration record yet
按计划时段累加 · {done_timed}/{complete} 次有记录: Summed by planned slot · {done_timed}/{complete} have a record
按每块自己的计划时段累加（不是计时器）: Summed by each block's own planned slot (not a timer)
库里存着的所有行为事件（含本页没有展开的类型）: Every action event stored in the database (including types not broken out on this page)
还没有记录 —— 用一会儿再来: No records yet — use the app for a while and come back
最近 12 周还没有记录: No records in the last 12 weeks yet
数字会跟着 Ctrl+Z 撤销一起回退 —— 它记的就是你真做过的操作。: The numbers roll back together with Ctrl+Z — they record what you actually did.
拖动改开始时间（15 分钟步进）: Drag to change the start time (15-minute steps)
拖动改时长（15 分钟步进；拖到下一列就续到次日）: Drag to change the duration (15-minute steps; drag to the next column to continue into the next day)
来自每周重复：{repeat_note}（删掉这一块 = 这周不再生成；规则在: From a weekly repeat: {repeat_note} (deleting this block means it won't be generated again this week; the rule lives in the ⚙ in Backlog)
选中后再点一下这里 = 改名（双击整块 = 标记完成）: With it selected, click here again to rename (double-click the block to mark it done)
点=拿起线头（再点另一个块接进序列）；右键=从序列里取出: Click = pick up the connector (click another block to link it into a sequence); right-click = remove from the sequence
模板：把某一周的骨架存下来，下次一键铺开: Templates: save a week's skeleton, then apply it in one click
还没有模板 —— 在下面把某一周存成模板: No templates yet — save a week as a template below
把骨架铺到正在看的那一周（Ctrl+Z 可撤销）: Lay the skeleton over the week you're viewing (Ctrl+Z to undo)
保存这一周为模板: Save this week as a template
这一周没有可保存的块（残影不算）: This week has no blocks to save (remnants don't count)
从模板里去掉这一块: Remove this block from the template
复制中：{range} · 左键放下 / Esc 取消: Copying: {range} · left click to drop / Esc to cancel
搬移中：{range} · 左键放下 / Esc 取消: Moving: {range} · left click to drop / Esc to cancel
键盘暂不支持序列操作：接链点两个块的 ⛓、解链点右键（键盘暂不搬块）: Keyboard doesn't do sequences yet: click the ⛓ on two blocks to link, right-click to unlink (no keyboard block-moving yet)
周六、周日已隐藏（设置 → 外观 / 布局 里可改）；点一下恢复显示: Saturday & Sunday are hidden (change it in Settings → Appearance / layout); click to show them again
拿好了：点另一个块的 ⛓ 接上 · ←/→ 可跳周 · 点空白或 Esc 取消: Holding it: click the ⛓ on another block to link · ←/→ to change weeks · click empty space or Esc to cancel
点一下看这一天的复盘明细: Click to see that day's review details
这是前一天那个块延下来的: This continues a block from the previous day
当前：便携（应用文件夹里的 data\\）: Current: portable (data\ inside the app folder)
这份还不能用: This one can't be used yet
把设置项恢复到默认值（界面语言保留）；任务、块、模板、统计、成就都不会被删。: Puts every setting back to its default value (your interface language is kept). Your tasks, blocks, templates, statistics and achievements are not deleted.
设置已恢复默认值（界面语言保留）: Settings restored to defaults (interface language kept)
在模板面板旁显示迷你周视图（0:00–24:00）；悬停保存区某一行时对应块会高: Shows a mini week view (00:00–24:00) beside the template panel; hovering a row highlights its block. Hidden on narrow windows.
双击刻度栏可以复位时间刻度: Double-click the ruler to reset the time scale
完成时不晚于「计划结束 + 15 分钟」算按时 —— 与块上的「超时」是同一条线: A block counts as on time when it is completed no later than its planned end + 15 minutes — the same line as the overtime badge on the block
有时长记录的完成块的平均计划时长 —— 不是实际花费: Average planned length of completions that have a time record — not actual time spent
连续的本地日里每天至少完成 1 块；中间断一天就重新数: Days in a row with at least one completion; one missed day resets it
近 14 天 · 最多 {max} 次: Last 14 days · up to {max} per day
分类记账上线前的旧账，以及没设分类的完成 —— 只算条数与计划时长: Records from before category tracking, and completions without a category — counts and planned time only
点一枚键帽开始录，按新键；Esc 取消。: Click a keycap, then press the new key. Esc cancels.
这个组合被系统占用，应用收不到。: That combination is taken by the system — the app never sees it.
这个组合被窗口自己占用（刷新 / 打印 / 缩放 / 开发者工具），换一个。: The window itself uses that combination (refresh / print / zoom / dev tools) — pick another.
「{combo}」已经是「{label}」的键位 —— 想用它就先改那一条。: “{combo}” is already used by “{label}” — change that one first if you want it.
已保存「{combo}」：它和「{label}」（{scope}）重合 —— 撞: Saved “{combo}”: it also matches “{label}” ({scope}) — which one wins depends on the layer.
保存失败，键位没改 —— 看提示条。: Couldn't save — the binding was not changed (see the toast).
搬移（跟鼠标，左键放下）: Move (follows the mouse, left click drops)
复制（跟鼠标，左键放下）: Copy (follows the mouse, left click drops)
{rated}/{complete} 条同时有「时长 + 延迟」记录: {rated}/{complete} have both a duration and a delay record
这个键管操作（拿起 / 放下 / 撤销），或已被默认键位占用 —— 想拿回这一行: That key manages operations (pick up / drop / undo), or it is taken by a default binding — use “Reset” to get this row's default key back.
分类在完成那一刻记进账本；以后改名或合并分类，不会回改旧账。分类已不存在的旧账行: Categories are recorded at the moment of completion; renaming or merging later will not change past records. Rows whose category no longer exists are shown without a colour dot.
不计入精力（这条任务整体不算；开关在 Backlog 那一行）: Excluded from energy (the whole task is out; the toggle is on the Backlog row)
重新计入精力：这一块现在不算进每天的占用: Count in energy again: this block doesn't count toward daily usage right now
不计入精力：这一块不算进每天的占用（再点一下恢复）: Exclude from energy: this block doesn't count toward daily usage (click again to restore)
